definitions.full: H1335. bether [ בֶּ֫תֶר ] noun masculine Gen 15:10 part, piece . 1 בִּתְרוֺ Gen 15:10 ; plural suffix בְּתָרָיו Jer 34:18 , הָעֵגֶל בִּתְרֵי 34:19 ; always of halves of animals cut in two in making covenants. 2 בָּ֑תֶר הָרֵי Song 2:17 mountains of cutting , i.e. cleft mountains ᵐ5 Thes and others; or of separation (between us) Ew and others; according to We Prol. 415, Eng. Tr. 391 ׳ב = malobathron . — Bether as proper name AV RV.
